# 06.02-replace-legacy-controls: Replace removed legacy WinForms controls

## Objective
Replace or adapt legacy WinForms controls removed or changed in modern .NET (e.g., StatusBar, MainMenu, ToolBar) to supported equivalents (MenuStrip, ToolStrip, StatusStrip).

## Steps
1. Inventory usages of legacy controls.
2. Replace occurrences or provide shims/adapters.
3. Update designer files accordingly.

**Done when**: No remaining references to removed legacy control types or documented exceptions for replacements.
